questions.title: The screen's job is clear from the first screen
questions.why: 'Listing 1' with prefilled 'Category', 'Listing title', 'Condition', 'Brand' and a 'List it!' button reads clearly as a review-and-post form.

questions.title: The action that does the job stands out most
questions.why: The full-width teal 'List it!' bar is the strongest element on screen.

questions.title: Every label says what happens when tapped
questions.why: 'Clear details' and the trash icon are clear, but 'Post all' and 'List it!' sit on the same screen with one item and don't say how they differ.

questions.title: No terms this user wouldn't know
questions.why: Every field label ('Category', 'Condition', 'Brand') is everyday listing language.

questions.title: Only asks what this user can decide at this stage
questions.why: Fields arrive filled ('Dresses', 'Like new', 'Love Bonito'), so the seller only confirms what they can see in their own photo.

questions.title: Advanced detail is tucked away
questions.why: Category, Condition and Brand pickers sit behind chevrons; only the core fields show on the first screen.

questions.title: Everything fits this stage and this user
questions.why: Everything shown is about getting this item listed.

questions.title: Little reading needed to act
questions.why: The only sentence is the one-line hint 'Tap to edit photos. Drag and drop to reorder.'
